_views.text: Audio_System is the auditory channel of Luna. It listens to LUNA_STATE_CHANGE messages on the bus and translates Luna's state into sound using the Solfège healing frequencies (396–963 Hz). It has three sub-systems: Synthesis_System manages oscillators and spatial audio, Ritual_Sound_System maps each of the 8 ritual keywords to a sonic signature (frequency sweeps, wave shapes, durations), and Ambient_System maintains a continuous background soundscape that changes with Luna's state. A non-visual user opens the application and immediately hears which state Luna is in — without any interaction. As sprites orbit, their sound pans left-to-right based on orbital angle, encoding position in space. Audio_System is not a feature added for accessibility. It is a first-class channel carrying the same state as Visual_System.
